terms.name: Governança e Supervisão
terms.description: Formal organizational structures and policy frameworks that establish human oversight mechanisms and decision protocols to ensure human accountability, ethical conduct, and risk management throughout AI development and deployment.

terms.name: Estrutura de conselho e supervisão
terms.description: Governance structures and leadership roles that establish executive accountability for AI safety and risk management.

terms.name: Gestão de riscos
terms.description: Systematic methods that identify, evaluate, and manage AI risks for comprehensive risk governance across organizations.

terms.name: Proteção contra conflitos de interesse
terms.description: Governance mechanisms that manage financial interests and organizational structures to ensure leadership can prioritize safety over profit motives in critical situations.

terms.name: Canal de denúncia e proteção ao denunciante
terms.description: Policies and systems that enable confidential reporting of safety concerns or ethical violations to prevent retaliation and encourage disclosure of risks.

terms.name: Estruturas de decisão de segurança
terms.description: Protocols and commitments that constrain decision-making about model development, deployment, and capability scaling, and govern safety-capability resource allocation to prevent unsafe AI advancement.

terms.name: Gestão de impacto ambiental
terms.description: Processes for measuring, reporting, and reducing the environmental footprint of AI systems to ensure sustainability and responsible resource use.

terms.name: Avaliação de impacto social
terms.description: Processes that assess AI systems' effects on society, including impacts on employment, power dynamics, political processes, and cultural values.

terms.name: Técnica e Segurança
terms.description: Technical, physical, and engineering safeguards that secure AI systems and constrain model behaviors to ensure security, safety, alignment with human values, and content integrity.

terms.name: Segurança do modelo e da infraestrutura
terms.description: Technical and physical safeguards that secure AI models, weights, and infrastructure to prevent unauthorized access, theft, tampering, and espionage.

terms.name: Alinhamento do modelo
terms.description: Technical methods to ensure AI systems understand and adhere to human values and intentions.

terms.name: Engenharia de segurança do modelo
terms.description: Technical methods and safeguards that constrain model behaviors and protect against exploitation and vulnerabilities.

terms.name: Controles de segurança de conteúdo
terms.description: Technical systems and processes that detect, filter, and label AI-generated content to identify misuse and enable content provenance tracking.

terms.name: Processos Operacionais
terms.description: Processes and management frameworks governing AI system deployment, usage, monitoring, incident handling, and validation, which promote safety, security, and accountability throughout the system lifecycle.

terms.name: Testes e auditoria
terms.description: Systematic internal and external evaluations that assess AI systems, infrastructure, and compliance processes to identify risks, verify safety, and ensure performance meets standards.

terms.name: Governança de dados
terms.description: Policies and procedures that govern responsible data acquisition, curation, and usage to ensure compliance, quality, user privacy, and removal of harmful content.

terms.name: Gestão de acesso
terms.description: Operational policies and verification systems that govern who can use AI systems and for what purposes to prevent safety circumvention, deliberate misuse, and deployment in high-risk contexts.

terms.name: Implantação em etapas
terms.description: Implementation protocols that deploy AI systems in stages, requiring safety validation before expanding user access or capabilities.

terms.name: Monitoramento pós-implantação
terms.description: Ongoing monitoring processes that track AI behavior, user interactions, and societal impacts post-deployment to detect misuse, emergent dangerous capabilities, and harmful effects.

terms.name: Resposta a incidentes e recuperação
terms.description: Protocols and technical systems that respond to security incidents, safety failures, or capability misuse to contain harm and restore safe operations.

terms.name: Transparência e Responsabilização
terms.description: Formal disclosure practices and verification mechanisms that communicate AI system information and enable external scrutiny to build trust, facilitate oversight, and ensure accountability to users, regulators, and the public.

terms.name: Documentação do sistema
terms.description: Comprehensive documentation protocols that record technical specifications, intended uses, capabilities, and limitations of AI systems to enable informed evaluation and governance.

terms.name: Divulgação de riscos
terms.description: Formal reporting protocols and notification systems that communicate risk information, mitigation plans, safety evaluations, and significant AI activities to enable external oversight and inform stakeholders.

terms.name: Relato de incidentes
terms.description: Formal processes and protocols that document and share AI safety incidents, security breaches, near-misses, and relevant threat intelligence with appropriate stakeholders to enable coordinated responses and systemic improvements.

terms.name: Divulgação da governança
terms.description: Formal disclosure mechanisms that communicate governance structures, decision frameworks, and safety commitments to enhance transparency and enable external oversight of high-stakes AI decisions.

terms.name: Acesso de terceiros ao sistema
terms.description: Mechanisms granting controlled system access to vetted external parties to enable independent assessment, validation, and safety research of AI models and capabilities.

terms.name: Direitos e recursos dos usuários
terms.description: Frameworks and procedures that enable users to identify and understand AI system interactions, report issues, request explanations, and seek recourse or remediation when affected by AI systems.
